name: strawberry-jam
description: strawberry jam is my personal fork of the project jam created and developed by sxip.

scripts.client:install: npm install --prefix assets/client --no-audit --no-fund && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('assets/client/node_modules/strawberry-jam', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.prepare:app: npm run css && npm run pack
scripts.dev: npm run prepare:app && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.test: npm run prepare:app && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron .
scripts.build: npm run prepare:app && node scripts/generate-installer-script.js && electron-builder build -w
scripts.publish: npm run prepare:app && node scripts/generate-installer-script.js && electron-builder build -w -p always
